value.innerText:
Prompt to working form

Fields, field types, validation, conditional logic, a progress indicator, and the thank-you state, generated in one pass. A no code form builder that still hands you the code.

Real database, no response cap

Every submission from your online forms writes to a database in your project. Query it, export it, or build a dashboard on it, with no monthly limit and no vendor lock-in.

Conditional, calculated, and scored

Show fields by answer, calculate a quote, score an applicant, and route by outcome. Logic a custom form builder usually needs a developer for, included from the free tier.

Payments inside the form

Stripe and PayPal are built in. Take one-time payments or subscriptions as a step in the form flow, with every payment saved next to its submission in your database.

Native integrations, plus webhooks

Every submission can sync natively to HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Slack, or Zapier. Anything else connects over a webhook.

Full code export to your repository

The form, the backend, and the database schema all export to your GitHub. Keep hosting on Emergent or take it anywhere, along with every submission you have collected.

Trigger anything downstream on submit, on payment, or on score.
If it has an API, your form can use it.
Emergent connects to any service with an API. No approved-partner list, no waiting for an integration to ship.
Based on each vendor's published plans, checked September 2026.

props.value: How to create an online form
props.name: Heading

props.value: 01 Choose how you will build it
props.name: HW_Step_01_Title

props.value: Hand-code the form, use a drag and drop form builder like Typeform or Jotform, or use an AI form builder like Emergent. Hand-coding gives control at the cost of time. Drag and drop tools are quick, and most meter your responses. AI builders generate the form and give you the code.
props.name: HW_Step_01_des

props.value: 02 Define the purpose and the fields
props.name: HW_Step_02_Title

props.value: Contact, lead capture, application, intake, order, feedback. The purpose decides the fields. Ask for the minimum you need to act on the submission. Every extra field costs completions, and no analytics dashboard will make a bloated form perform better than a short one.
props.name: HW_Step_02_des

props.value: 03 Plan the logic and the validation
props.name: HW_Step_03_Title

props.value: Decide which questions depend on earlier answers, what should be scored or calculated, where each outcome should route, and which fields need format checks. Write these as plain sentences; on Emergent they become the prompt that builds the form.
props.name: HW_Step_03_des

props.value: Describe the fields, the logic, and the destination, and the AI form generator builds the form around it. Field types, validation, conditional branches, progress indicator, and thank-you state included. Refine any part of the form by describing the change you want in a sentence.
props.name: HW_Step_04_des

props.value: Submissions write to your database by default. Add Google Sheets or HubSpot sync, a Slack alert, or a Stripe payment step with a sentence each. On most other tools, each integration is its own setup, with monthly caps to watch.
props.name: HW_Step_05_des

props.value: Complete the form on a phone, take every conditional branch, trigger each validation message, and confirm the test submission appears in the database and in every connected tool. Every bug you catch here saves a real submission that a real user would abandon.
props.name: HW_Step_06_des

props.value: Share the standalone link, embed the form, or run it as a popup. Watch completion rate and drop-off by field. If most people who start the form don't finish it, cut fields first, then improve from there.
